title: Application Process for Short-term Overseas

category.title: Less than 90 days
content: Who is elgible to apply for short-term study?

-A person living outside of the U.S.
-A person planning to stay in the U.S. less than 90 days.

category.title: Application Steps
content: Short-term international students do not need a visa. However it is recommended that you complete the application process as early as possible to secure housing and class registration.
MLI is especially busy during summer holidays and spring breaks. Therefore, even for short-term study,we recommend you complete the application at least two months prior to departure.

types.title: Cancellation Policy
content: The enrollment fee of $150, will be charged at the time of application. The enrollment fee is non-refundable regardless if an application is rejected or enrollment is cancelled. Exceptions include insufficient housing.

category.title: About the steps after application
content: After students have applied, the iMLI system processes the application. Students can follow the process which is listed on the iMLI.

types.title: Apply Online
content:
Fill out the information about your visa status
Contact us via iMLI for all inquiries
*Please have your credit card in hand.
